standard_prerequisites.name: The Godel sentence and its Q-form
standard_prerequisites.statement: The negation of the Godel sentence is equivalent in Q to the existential 'there is x with Prf_T(x, gG_T)' (the unit's equation eqn:qpf).
standard_prerequisites.use: It converts the derived existential into a derivation of the negated Godel sentence (496-498).

standard_prerequisites.name: Representability of the proof predicate in Q
standard_prerequisites.statement: When a derivation of a sentence exists, Q derives the corresponding numeral instance of the proof predicate (the unit's representability standard for Prf_T).
standard_prerequisites.use: It lifts the concrete witness m to a Q-derivation of OPrf_T(m-bar, gG_T) (491-494).

standard_prerequisites.name: Monotonicity of derivability
standard_prerequisites.statement: Whatever Q derives, every extension of Q derives as well.
standard_prerequisites.use: It carries the Q-refutation of the Godel sentence up to T (498-500).

core_obligations: Assume T derives G_T; then some m codes a derivation, so Prf_T(m, gG_T) holds (489-492).

By representability in Q, Q derives the numeral instance OPrf_T(m-bar, gG_T), and hence the existential over the proof predicate, which is by definition the provability predicate sentence OProv_T(gG_T) (492-496).
By the unit's Q-equivalence, Q derives the negation of G_T, and since T extends Q so does T (496-498).
Thus T would derive both G_T and its negation, contradicting consistency; so a consistent T does not derive G_T (500-502).

proof_roadmap.step: Assume the derivation and fix the witness m.
Lift the witness to a Q-derivation of the numeral instance and the existential.
Convert to the negated Godel sentence, carry it to T, and contradict consistency.

difficulty_reason: The counted lemma is the author lemma at source lines 484-487: a consistent axiomatizable theory extending Q does not prove its Godel sentence. The author proof (489-502) is a genuine reflective chain: assuming T derives G_T, representability of the proof predicate in Q turns some witness m into a Q-derivation of the numeral instance of the proof predicate, the existential follows, the unit's Q-equivalence identifies that existential with the negation of the Godel sentence, and monotonicity carries the refutation up to T, contradicting consistency. The self-reference loop must be kept straight, which is real work.
